why: A number that decides behaviour and was measured on the phone (CLAUDE.md mistake register 9) is defined once and imported. tools/test-measured-constants.ts refuses a second definition of a registered name, or of one of its aliases, as a numeric literal in TypeScript, JavaScript or Java: re-measuring one copy left the others stale.

DEFAULT_READY_DELAY_MS.measured: the delay from the start press to the night's first scheduled report

FUSION_POLL_MS.measured: Fusion's touch poll period, one frame at 30 fps

MIN_CONTACT_MS.measured: the shortest contact the phone delivers as a tap (docs/evidence/qualification-hid-mediaprojection-night5-20260912-contact200.json)

CUE_READ_MS.measured: one Companion visual read; observation-language.ts prices the same read as VISUAL_READ_COST_MS 59.5, a DECISION until one is re-measured on Companion 17

VISUAL_READ_COST_MS.measured: the model's price of one visual read (see CUE_READ_MS)

SEED_FLOOR.measured: not a measurement: the project's 3000-seed standard for a census or a gate
